d: The Miss Universe 2026 pageant has sparked a fresh controversy. Several contestants from African countries have been affected by US visa restrictions, putting their participation at risk. The controversy comes months after fans from countries including Haiti, Iran, Ivory Coast and Senegal faced travel hurdles during the FIFA World Cup. With Puerto Rico hosting the pageant, questions are mounting over America's role as a global host. Can the United States welcome the world if people from other nations cannot even get through its doors?
